reviews.title: Inconsistent data
reviews.text: I use an Apple Watch and iPhone, and my step data is critical to me as my health insurance provider rewards me based on keeping active. Unfortunately, this app seems to use its own logic to merge Apple Watch and iPhone data, rather than using the Apple Health APIs. Therefore it shows figures which don’t match the data used by other providers (like my health insurer), meaning I can’t rely on it.

reviews.title: Not at all accurate now
reviews.text:
I just deleted it. My Apple Watch and smartrings don’t pick up my walking on a walking pad while working (since my hand is resting on a keyboard/desk). So I figured I’d check in on the Pedometer app that I’ve had for two years, and keep my phone in my pocket as I walk. One mile on the pad = 5k steps?! Not likely. Not at all correct. Steps counter in Apple Health says 1.3k steps in that same time. 

Additionally, the Ped app has not been syncing correctly to my Watch SE since the new OS update came out last Sept. Could be due to the OS is not supported on my SE, but having to constantly tap into the Ped progress bar and wait for it to sync back to my phone is annoying when I just want to raise my wrist and see where my count is. Double that up with now the app is not even accurate on my phone, and yeah - delete. 

Please let me know when you’ve fixed and I’ll redownload and resume my happy ways.
